paletteDescriptions.modifyEntity: Changes selected fields or status on an existing entity.
paletteDescriptions.defineStatus: Defines a reusable entity lifecycle state and its evidence requirements.
paletteDescriptions.deconstructEntity: Exposes the entity's declared blocks as typed outputs.
paletteDescriptions.selectEntities: Reads an organization-scoped list of the selected entity type.
paletteDescriptions.composeBlock: Builds one reusable structural block from selected values.
paletteDescriptions.modifyBlock: Copies a structural block and replaces only connected selected values.
paletteDescriptions.valueInput: Produces one editable value of the selected type.
paletteDescriptions.logic: Compares values or combines Boolean conditions.
paletteDescriptions.date: Adds, subtracts, compares, or normalizes dates.
paletteDescriptions.sliceList: Returns the items between start and end positions.
paletteDescriptions.filterList: Keeps list items whose matching mask value is true.
paletteDescriptions.collectArray: Collects each branch into one intrinsic array value.
paletteDescriptions.expandArray: Expands one intrinsic array value into branch items.
paletteDescriptions.reverseItems: Reverses items independently in every branch.
paletteDescriptions.shiftItems: Moves branch items by a connected offset.
paletteDescriptions.partitionItems: Splits each branch into chunks of the selected size.
paletteDescriptions.dispatchItems: Separates items into true and false outputs using a mask.
paletteDescriptions.cleanTree: Removes null items and empty branches.
paletteDescriptions.treeStatistics: Reports branch paths and item counts without changing data.
paletteDescriptions.simplifyTree: Removes redundant paths from a data tree.
paletteDescriptions.unzipLists: Separates paired list values into tree branches.
paletteDescriptions.crossLists: Produces every pair between two lists.
paletteDescriptions.transposeTree: Swaps rows and columns in a data tree.
paletteDescriptions.manualEvent: Starts when a user runs the process.
paletteDescriptions.entityEvent: Starts automatically for the selected entity type.
paletteDescriptions.domainEvent: Starts automatically for the selected registered event.
paletteDescriptions.continueAtDate: Pauses a running process and emits an event at the connected date.
paletteDescriptions.whenStarted: Starts the process manually and provides its start data.
paletteDescriptions.currentTime: Produces the current date and time.
paletteDescriptions.numberValue: Produces a number you enter here.
paletteDescriptions.yesNoValue: Produces a true or false value.
paletteDescriptions.listValue: Produces a fixed list of values.
paletteDescriptions.fallbackValue: Uses the first available non-empty value.
paletteDescriptions.compareValues: Tests two values and produces true or false.
paletteDescriptions.combineConditions: Combines true/false values with AND, OR, or NOT.
paletteDescriptions.currentEntity: Reads the entity that started the process.
paletteDescriptions.findEntityById: Loads one entity from its type and ID.
paletteDescriptions.findEntityByReference: Loads one entity from a connected typed reference.
paletteDescriptions.findEntities: Queries entities, optionally using connected conditions.
paletteDescriptions.relatedEntities: Loads entities related to another entity.
paletteDescriptions.readField: Extracts one typed field value from a connected block.
paletteDescriptions.readBlock: Extracts one complete block from an entity.
paletteDescriptions.setField: Creates one field change from a value.
paletteDescriptions.combineFieldChanges: Combines independent field changes into one change set.
paletteDescriptions.applyFieldChanges: Applies a change set to entity data without saving it.
paletteDescriptions.composeEntityData: Builds typed entity data from selected fields.
paletteDescriptions.decomposeEntity: Exposes selected entity fields as separate outputs.
paletteDescriptions.parentEntity: Loads the parent of an entity.
paletteDescriptions.childEntities: Loads the children of an entity.
paletteDescriptions.fieldCondition: Tests one entity field against a value.
paletteDescriptions.combineFilters: Combines field conditions with AND, OR, or NOT.
paletteDescriptions.filterEntities: Keeps only entities that satisfy connected conditions.
paletteDescriptions.createEntity: Creates an entity from the selected typed field sockets.
paletteDescriptions.updateEntity: Sets the selected fields or status on the connected entity.
paletteDescriptions.changeStatus: Changes an entity to the connected status.
paletteDescriptions.runService: Runs a registered service with connected inputs.
paletteDescriptions.sendEntity: Sends an entity to another organization.
paletteDescriptions.generateAttachment: Generates and attaches a registered document.
paletteDescriptions.choosePath: Continues on the true or false path.
paletteDescriptions.forEachEntity: Runs one branch once for every entity in a list.
paletteDescriptions.waitUntilTime: Pauses until the connected date and time.
paletteDescriptions.parallelPaths: Starts multiple branches at the same time.
paletteDescriptions.joinAllPaths: Continues after every connected branch finishes.
paletteDescriptions.joinAnyPath: Continues after the first connected branch finishes.
paletteDescriptions.makeList: Wraps one item as a typed list.
paletteDescriptions.packArray: Packs a wire list into one array-valued item for a block field.
paletteDescriptions.unpackArray: Expands one array-valued item into a wire list.
paletteDescriptions.joinProducers: Explicitly converges same-type producer paths under one selected producer output.
paletteDescriptions.itemAtPosition: Reads one item at a numeric position.
paletteDescriptions.listCount: Produces the number of items in a list.
paletteDescriptions.sortItems: Orders comparable items in a list.
paletteDescriptions.removeDuplicates: Removes repeated items from a list.
paletteDescriptions.groupItems: Groups items into branches using an aligned key list.
paletteDescriptions.flattenTree: Turns tree branches into one list.
paletteDescriptions.graftTree: Turns list items into separate tree branches.
paletteDescriptions.treeBranch: Reads one branch from a data tree.
paletteDescriptions.zipLists: Pairs items at matching positions in two lists.
